assumptions: Every conclusion is uniform only over the full inherited root bracket 1 and one displayed real lambda box at a time; root uniqueness is not assumed.

The upstream actual-direction theorem and rho barrier are reused only on x>=3. The new local Taylor calculation starts at the exact rational Q_switch=-29/10 after an executable C*exp(Q_switch)>3 check.

The scale-free initial state discards only a nonzero common amplitude. It retains the full rho interval, so the compact calculation validates an outer transfer for every barrier-admissible direction; the selected actual direction is contained in that outer family but is not separately localized at Q_switch.
Every local Taylor remainder uses whole-step coefficient-derivative bounds, not a midpoint or floating-point residual.
A useful scale-free enclosure does not make the Q=4-normalized absolute Gamma_1 narrow and does not by itself establish a root, spectrum, RAQ or physics.

declared_conventions.compact_partition: 16 exact-rational backward steps h=-11/160 from Q_switch=-29/10 to Q_0=-4.
declared_conventions.execution: SymPy exact identities plus python-flint Arb local interval Taylor and Bessel regression; no SciPy ODE, quadrature, root, finite difference or sampling grid
declared_conventions.minus_tail: The inherited rotating-frame Volterra masses bound the complete Q<-4 correction after division by the certified nonzero v(-4).
declared_conventions.plus_normalization: The actual recessive direction selected upstream is rescaled at Q_switch so v(Q_switch)=1; the x>=3 rho barrier proves this divisor is positive.
declared_conventions.scale_free_characteristic: g_lambda=Gamma_1(v)/v(-4), formed only if the final v(-4) interval excludes zero; it has the same zero set as Gamma_1 within this certified scope.
declared_conventions.switch_guard: C*exp(Q_switch)>3, so rho=-u_Q/u-x-1/2 remains in [-1,1] and v_Q(Q_switch)=-(x+1/2+rho).
declared_conventions.switch_state_scope: rho(Q_switch) is enclosed by the inherited full interval [-1,1]. The emitted state box therefore contains every barrier-admissible direction and only outer-encloses the selected actual direction; it is not a new sharp Q=4-to-Q_switch transport.
declared_conventions.taylor_convention: Actual derivatives Y^(n) use the binomial Leibniz recurrence; the endpoint polynomial divides once by n!, and the whole-step remainder is D_13*|h|^13/13!.

exact_checks.statement: The Q and x forms of the actual raw-C coefficient agree.
The x-frame Riccati equation is the exact Q equation divided by x.
For ell=log u and r=-u_Q/u, ell_x=-r/x.
The first whole-step coefficient derivative used by the Taylor majorant is exact.
The second whole-step coefficient derivative used by the Taylor majorant is exact.
The actual-derivative Leibniz recurrence gives the displayed second state derivative.
A nonzero common amplitude rescaling preserves v_Q/v.
When v(Q0) is nonzero, Gamma_1(v)/v(Q0) has the declared quotient form.
Sixteen exact steps h=-11/160 join Q_switch=-29/10 to Q0=-4.
The configured root bracket is exactly the upstream root-1 120-digit sign-changing Bessel bracket, not merely a subinterval of (2,3).
The compact outer transfer is bound to the upstream Q endpoints, root box, lambda boxes, actual-recessive normalization and x>=3 rho-barrier convention.
The quotient-tail calculation uses the pinned nonzero-lambda Gamma_1 boundary identity at the same Q0 and C convention.
The full inherited root-1 exact bracket lies in (2,3).
Both lambda-zero precision tiers make exactly the declared three Bessel calls.

theorem_guards.conclusion_and_scope: The full inherited rho box is reused at the rational switch. It outer-encloses the actual direction but neither substitutes a WKB proxy nor newly sharpens the Q=4-to-switch transport.
theorem_guards.hypotheses: The selected actual family is normalized at Q=4 and has rho in [-1,1] with u>0 while x>=3.
theorem_guards.theorem: DLMF Liouville--Green actual recessive solution plus the pinned rho invariant-region proof

theorem_guards.conclusion_and_scope: This is a validated analytic local transfer, not a SciPy or black-box numerical ODE call.
theorem_guards.hypotheses: Each exact-rational step uses full kappa/lambda boxes, actual derivative jets through order 12, a Gronwall state tube and D_13 |h|^13/13! remainder.
theorem_guards.theorem: Taylor theorem with whole-step derivative majorants

theorem_guards.conclusion_and_scope: The resulting g has the same zeros as Gamma_1 only within the certified parameter boxes; no root continuation is inferred.
theorem_guards.hypotheses: The barrier makes the actual switch amplitude positive; the propagated full outer box must exclude zero at Q0 before division.

theorem_guards.conclusion_and_scope: The bound closes the complete selected-reference left tail only; it supplies no spectral measure or RAQ.
theorem_guards.hypotheses: The potential and forcing masses are integrable and the Q0 scale-free state is finite with nonzero first component.
theorem_guards.theorem: Rotating-frame variation of constants and Gronwall on Q<-4

theorem_guards.conclusion_and_scope: Absolute Q4-normalized Gamma_1 sharpness, global zeros, spectrum, RAQ, quantum gravity, physics and TOE remain null.
theorem_guards.hypotheses: One inherited kappa bracket, two real lambda boxes, the full barrier-admissible switch box, one fixed extension reference and same-backend 80/120-digit refinements.

validated_calculation.interpretation: The output is a scale-free endpoint and complete selected-reference quotient-tail outer enclosure for every barrier-admissible switch state. It contains the selected actual family but does not newly sharpen its Q4-to-switch direction, make Q4-normalized absolute Gamma_1 narrow, or continue roots.

partial_progress.scope: Executable partial facts remain valid even when the aggregate preregistered width verdict fails.
